name: יוֹחָנָן
summary: יְהוֹ־ or יוֹ־, Yahweh, with the verb חָנַן, “Yahweh has been gracious”: Hananiah with the divine name first. Above all Johanan son of Kareah, the captain who warned Gedaliah of Ishmael's plot, rescued the captives at Gibeon, and then asked Jeremiah to pray for the remnant, promising to obey, but would not hear Yahweh's word to stay in the land and led the remnant into Egypt (2Ki 25:23; Jer 40:8–43:7). Also the firstborn of Josiah (1Ch 3:15), a priest of the line of Zadok (1Ch 5:35–36), two warriors who joined David at Ziklag (1Ch 12:5, 13), a gatekeeper (1Ch 26:3), a captain of Jehoshaphat (2Ch 17:15), the fathers of captains under Jehoiada and in Ephraim (2Ch 23:1; 28:12), a descendant of David (1Ch 3:24), and in the return the son of Eliashib in whose chamber Ezra mourned (Ezr 10:6; Neh 12:22–23), returning exiles (Ezr 8:12; 10:28), a son of Tobiah the Ammonite (Neh 6:18) and priests (Neh 12:13, 42). In the New Testament it is Ἰωάννης, John: the angel told Zacharias “your supplication is heard … you shall call his name John”, when “the Lord had magnified his mercy” on Elisabeth (Luk 1:13, 58–63).

evidence.note: “Johanan son of Kareah”, among the captains who came to Gedaliah.
Johanan warned Gedaliah of Ishmael, and was not believed.
“Pray for us to Yahweh your God … whether good or evil we will obey the voice of Yahweh our God.”
“You speak falsely; Yahweh our God has not sent you … so Johanan … did not obey the voice of Yahweh to remain in the land of Judah.”
“The sons of Josiah: the firstborn יוֹחָנָן.”
Ezra “went into the chamber of יְהוֹחָנָן son of Eliashib … for he mourned over the unfaithfulness of the exiles”.
“Your supplication (δέησις) is heard, and your wife Elisabeth shall bear you a son, and you shall call his name John (Ἰωάννης).” The Peshitta writes ܝܘܚܢܢ.
“The Lord had magnified his mercy on her” (the Peshitta's חְנָנֵהּ); “his name is John”.

note: Takes e.az.ak (יְהוֹחָנָן) and e.az.bj (יוֹחָנָן, a cross-reference), BDB's keys under הוה; no entry claimed them. TIPNR's keys use the English numbering (1Ch.6.9 = Hebrew 1Ch 5:35; 1Ch.12.4 and 12.12 = Hebrew 12:5 and 12:13). TIPNR takes Josiah's firstborn Johanan (1Ch 3:15) to be Jehoahaz (Jehoahaz@2Ki.23.30), and its Johanan@Neh.12.11 is also called Jonathan; both are tagged as TIPNR has them. The New Testament Johns (John the Baptist, the apostle, Joanan of Luk 3:27) bear the name in Greek but are not tagged here.
